newsitem.title: UK: Austria eyes $500 mln five-year bond -bankers.
newsitem.headline: Austria eyes $500 mln five-year bond -bankers.

text.p: Austria is considering launching a $500 million five-year Eurobond soon, bankers said on Wednesday.
Spread talk was around two basis points over U.S. Treasury notes. There was no clear indication as to which bank would lead manage the issue, they said.
This year triple-A rated Austria has tapped a variety of European currencies.
Earlier this month it issued a 1.0 billion guilder 30-year bond at 14 b.p. over DSLs, which would convert into a 30-year Austrian bund after EMU.
In January Austria became the first borrower to launch a Eurobond which would redenominate into euros after EMU with a 5.0 billion French franc bond, priced to yield seven b.p. over OATs.
A host of other borrowers, including European sovereigns, companies and banks, have since issued similar transactions. -- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
